title: Connected color fill
summary: Click to fill a connected region with color and opacity, control matching tolerance, and undo the complete change.

Added: More > Fill provides color, opacity and tolerance controls for connected image regions.
Images with editable objects show a Flatten and fill review before applying; Cancel keeps the project unchanged.
One Undo restores pixels and editable objects. Filled projects retain original source pixels for Revert.
Verified: Native region selection, Cancel, translucent fill, Undo/Redo, save and actual clipboard output pass synthetic checks.
Independent flood filling matches all 256000 saved pixels, including 190762 changed background pixels.
Shared-engine tests cover barriers, diagonals, seed-relative tolerance, transparent colors, large regions, no-op history and persistence.

limitations: Fill operates on four-connected regions of the complete image. Selection masks, global replacement and antialiased fill remain unfinished.
Applying fill to annotations flattens them after review; Undo restores editability. Editable projects retain the original image.
This unsigned historical alpha covers only the workflows verified in its release notes.
